messages:
Marta: Quick heads-up — I'm going to land a small refresh to the minidemo onboarding this afternoon. Goal: clarify the token flow (short-lived vs. env var), fix the serverless deploy snippet, and add a tiny Node + Py example for first-run.
Raj: SGTM. Can you paste the PR when it's up? I want to check the text around 'client-side token usage' — we have a few customers still confusing the sample.
Marta: Yep will open as WIP. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/487 — includes changes to /get-started/minidemo and replaces the old curl snippet.
DocBot: PR #487 opened by Marta — status: CI pending · files changed: 3 · reviewers requested: @Chris, @Olivia
Chris: Quick note — the current sample uses REDWOOD_API_KEY in README but our onboarding guide standard is REDWOOD_KEY. Pick one and I'll update the SDK snippets. Recommend keeping REDWOOD_KEY (shorter).
Olivia: +1 for REDWOOD_KEY. Also add a short paragraph about ephemeral keys for in-browser demos and link to the token best-practices page. Something like: "Do not embed long-lived keys in front-end bundles — use a short-lived token service."
Marta: Good call. I'll replace the env name and add a 2-line callout about ephemeral tokens pointing to /security/tokens.
Ben: I can take the Node + Python examples. Suggest we also include a tiny serverless deploy example for Vercel with `vercel env add REDWOOD_KEY` so people can copy/paste.
Raj: For the serverless example, can we also show a minimal config for cold-start mitigation? Maybe a note to enable small warmup pings or recommend model variant with lower init-time. Keep it 1-2 lines.
Marta: Will do. Proposed curl snippet (will land in PR):
```bash
# exchange short-lived session token for server key on trusted backend
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/token/exchange \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SESSION_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"scope":"inference:basic"}'

# call generation
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-1-small","input":"Hello"}'
```
Chris: Nice. When you swap the env var I'll run a quick grep across docs to update remaining occurrences. If you want, I can push a follow-up commit to normalize variable names.
Marta: Please do that, thanks.
DocBot: CI passed for PR #487 — checks: markdown-lint, link-check, snippet-run (node, python) · status: green
Olivia: One more tiny nit — update the Python example to use the `with client.open_stream()` pattern we recommend in the SDK guide. I can paste the short snippet if you want.
Ben: I'll add the Vercel line and the Node/Py snippets in a follow-up commit. Tag me for a quick review.
Marta: Awesome — plan: land PR with the text and curl example, then Ben & Chris to follow up with language-specific snippets + grep fix. Target: today EOD. Thanks all :rocket:
Raj: Thanks! I'll skim before merge and watch for any customer-facing wording.
DocBot: PR #487 merged by Marta — merge commit: 9f3b2a1 · deployment: none (docs site build queued)
